title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 10, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: High (M1.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: M6.4 (Peaked October 10, 2026 at 15:10 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 551 km/s (Fast)
🧲 Bz: +20.9 nT (Strongly Northward)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Geomagnetic K-index of 5

M-Class flare activity! The solar wind has places to be. 💥💨💣🌎

Today’s solar images show several bright active regions and broad dark coronal structures, with no clear large CME visible in the coronagraph.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
